notes.title: The Guiding Spirit - Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
The adventure begins...

Hey folks!

I'm very excited to announce The Guiding Spirit and put up its Steam page!
If you didn't see the announcement trailer, check it out below!

[previewyoutube="GyZW3hqXc8A;full"][/previewyoutube]Upcoming Demo
The game is feature-complete and im currently pouring more and more content into it. You will have the chance to try out the game yourself soon, as there will be a free demo, coming later this year. The content for the demo is already playable but I want it to be as polished as possible and completely (if such thing exists in the videogame industry) bug-free so you have the best possible experience when the time comes. 


Updates
Over the next months, be on the lookout for regular updates on the game’s several features and behind-the-scenes looks at some of the creative processes going into The Guiding Spirit.
As an example, I plan to cover each aspect of Character Creation:
•	Ancestries
•	Deities
•	Constellations
•	Origins
•	Core Memories
•	Aspirations
•	Capabilities
•	Personality
•	Skills
•	Proficiencies
•	Special Abilities
•	Items
•	Followers


Credit
Before i go I would like to credit the much-talented Misterbates (Kristof Rety) for the incredible music piece he created for the trailer (his channel can be found here). I’m going to share more of his work in the future, there are some very cool in-game soundtracks coming your way!

I’m also working with an illustrator for some special art to be added in the game, keep an eye out on the following updates for more info!

Until the next update,
Dice Impact
